analyst_view.overall: Celta (27th, 3 points) host Bournemouth (2nd, 12 points from four wins) at Balaidos, with Claudio Giraldez under pressure after Celta scored very little lately. Borja Iglesias and Carl Starfelt again stay out of the squad, Hugo Gonzalez has a thigh strain (counted) and Miguel Roman is still out, so Iago Aspas or Pablo Duran should lead the attack; Iglesias' absence already shows in Celta's poor scoring. Giraldez said Celta cannot manage minutes and will field their most competitive side, while Bournemouth miss Alex Toth, Julian Araujo and Juanlu Sanchez (all counted), with Kroupi not registered and Evanilson likely up front. Both sides play league games three days later, and German referee Harm Osmers books a little more than average, which the numbers count.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.9 goals, 1.2 for Celta and 1.8 for Bournemouth, and already trim Celta for scoring only 4 in their last 6 (-4.2%). Iglesias, Celta's main striker, is confirmed out again and the numbers don't list him, but Starfelt's absence at the back helps Bournemouth's Evanilson-led attack, so I stay only mildly lower, to about 2.8.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.3 corners, split fairly evenly. Giraldez wants a high tempo with Celta's wing-backs pushing on, and Bournemouth play direct and wide on the break; recent corner form is already in the numbers, so I stay at about 8.3.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.2 cards, already raised 14% for referee Harm Osmers (4.5 a game) and lowered for Bournemouth's few recent bookings. Bournemouth's aggressive press can cause fouls, but that is part of their record, and there is no rivalry here, so I stay at about 4.2.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.1 shots and already raise Celta for shooting a lot lately (+8.3%), even if few go in. Celta without Iglesias still shoot often from range, Giraldez promises his strongest side and Bournemouth's front line is close to full strength, so I stay at about 26.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.7 on target and already cut Celta's share for poor accuracy (-9.6%), which largely reflects playing without Iglesias. Bournemouth keep their side up with Evanilson available and Kroupi not registered, so I stay at about 8.7.
